=== task: init ===

  -address="http://127.0.0.1:8200" \
  -format=json > "$TMP"
  -key-shares=5 \
  -key-threshold=3 \
  echo "KEYS_FILE already exists: $KF. Move or remove it before running init again." >&2
  exit 1
TMP="${KF}.tmp.$$"
chmod 600 "$TMP"
echo "Vault initialized. Unseal keys and root token saved to $KF"
fi
if [ -e "$KF" ]; then
mv "$TMP" "$KF"
task: "_install:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:macos" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "init" finished
task: "init" started
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: Task "_install:macos" is up to date
task: [init] KF=".vault-init-keys.json"
task: status command command -v vault >/dev/null 2>&1 && { [ -z "" ] || vault version | grep -Fq "v"; } exited zero
trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
trap - EXIT
vault operator init \
